description: This file is a Python module that provides a framework for testing translation files (.po and .mo) in a project, including loading test modules, running tests, and modifying LINGUAS files.

methods.name: testFile
methods.description: Runs all registered translation tests against a specified .mo file, optionally removing files and updating LINGUAS in release mode.

methods.name: testSourceTree
methods.description: Runs all registered tests against all .po files in a given directory, optionally modifying LINGUAS files in release mode.
